name: الفئة لتمثيل قرض (الحالة 2)
description: قم ببناء فئة تمثل قرضًا. يجب أن تحتوي هذه الفئة على بيانات تمثل معدل الفائدة السنوي، ومبلغ القرض، وطول فترة القرض (بالسنوات)؛ والتي لا يمكن الوصول إليها أو تغييرها إلا من خلال طرق الحصول (getter) والإعداد (setter). يجب إنشاء مثيل من الفئة بتحديد معدل الفائدة السنوي، وطول فترة القرض بالسنوات، ومبلغ القرض.\nيجب أن تحسب الطرق الأخرى في هذه الفئة مبلغ الدفعات الشهرية للقرض وكذلك إجمالي الدفعات.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Ta'reef al-fia
class Loan2 :
    #Khatwa 1.1: Ibtida al-qard bil-qiyam al-muhaddadah 
    def __init__(self, annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
    #Khatwa 1.2: Ta'reef al-method alati tahsib mablagh al-dafaat al-shahriyya 'ala al-qard
    def get_monthly_payment(self) :
        monthly_interest_rate = self.__annual_interest_rate / 12
        monthly_payment = self.__loan_amount * monthly_interest_rate / (1 -
                (1 / (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** (self.__number_of_years * 12) ))
        return monthly_payment    
    #Khatwa 1.3: Ta'reef al-method alati tahsib mablagh al-dafaat al-kulliyya 'ala al-qard
    def get_total_payment(self) :
        total_payment = self.get_monthly_payment() * self.__number_of_years * 12
        return total_payment
    #Khatwa 1.4: Ta'reef al-methodat li-husool/ta`yeed khasais al-qard
    def get_annual_interest_rate(self) :
        return self.__annual_interest_rate
    def set_annual_interest_rate(self, annual_interest_rate) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    def get_number_of_years(self) :
        return self.__number_of_years
    def set_number_of_years(self, number_of_years) :
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
    def get_loan_amount(self) :
        return self.__loan_amount
    def set_loan_amount(self, loan_amount) :
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
#Khatwa 2: Ikhtibar al-fia
annual_interest_rate = float(input("Adkhil nisbat al-faeeda al-sanawiya: "))
number_of_years = int(input("Adkhil adad al-sanawat li-muddat al-qard: "))
loan_amount = (float(input("Adkhil mablagh al-qard: ")))
loan2 = Loan2(annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount)
print("Al-dafaa al-shahriyya lil-qard hiya: {:.2f} ".format(loan2.get_monthly_payment()))
print("Al-dafaa al-kulli lil-qard huwa: {:.2f} ".format(loan2.get_total_payment()))

نحتاج إلى قراءة القيمة التي يدخلها المستخدم لمعدل الفائدة السنوي للقرض. لقراءة إدخال المستخدم من سطر الأوامر نستخدم الدالة input(). هذا السطر يطبع نصًا على الشاشة "Enter the annual interest rate: " ثم يقرأ النص الذي يدخله المستخدم.

القيمة المقروءة ستكون سلسلة نصية ويجب تحويلها إلى عدد عشري (float). نحوّل سلسلة الإدخال إلى قيمة float باستخدام الدالة float().

يمكن تحويل القيمة من سلسلة إلى float فقط إذا كانت السلسلة تمثل قيمة عشرية صالحة. أيضًا لاحظ أننا لا نضطر بالضرورة إلى تخزين القيمة المرجعة من دالة input في متغير؛ يمكننا استخدام نداء input مباشرة كوسيطة لدالة float.

untr_comments.content:
We need to read the value that the user enters for the loan's annual interest rate. To read the user input from command line, we use the input() function. This statement prints a text on the screen "Enter the annual interest rate: ", then reads the text entered by the user.

The value that will be read is a string and we need to convert it to a float. We convert the input string to its float representation by using the float() function.

The conversion of the value from string to float can only be done if the string could be translated into a valid floating-point value. Also note that we do not necessarily have to store the returned value from the input function in a variable. We could use the input function call directly as the float function parameter.

untr_name: The Class for Representing a Loan (Case 2)
untr_description: Construct a class that represents a loan. This class should contain data representing the interest rate, loan amount, and the length of loan period (in years); all of which could be accessed or changed only through the getter and setter methods. An instance of the class should be created by specifying annual interest rate, length of loan period, and loan amount.\nThe other methods of the this class should calculate the amount of monthly payments on the loan as well as the total payment.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Define the class
class Loan2 :
    #Step 1.1: Initialize the loan with the specified values 
    def __init__(self, annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
    #Step 1.2: Define the method that calculates the amount of monthly payments on the loan
    def get_monthly_payment(self) :
        monthly_interest_rate = self.__annual_interest_rate / 12
        monthly_payment = self.__loan_amount * monthly_interest_rate / (1 -
                (1 / (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** (self.__number_of_years * 12) ))
        return monthly_payment    
    #Step 1.3: Define the method that calculates the amount of total payments on the loan
    def get_total_payment(self) :
        total_payment = self.get_monthly_payment() * self.__number_of_years * 12
        return total_payment
    #Step 1.4: Define the methods to get/set the properties of the loan
    def get_annual_interest_rate(self) :
        return self.__annual_interest_rate
    def set_annual_interest_rate(self, annual_interest_rate) :
        self.__annual_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate
    def get_number_of_years(self) :
        return self.__number_of_years
    def set_number_of_years(self, number_of_years) :
        self.__number_of_years = number_of_years
    def get_loan_amount(self) :
        return self.__loan_amount
    def set_loan_amount(self, loan_amount) :
        self.__loan_amount = loan_amount
#Step 2: Test the class
annual_interest_rate = float(input("Enter the annual interest rate: "))
number_of_years = int(input("Enter the number of years for the loan period: "))
loan_amount = (float(input("Enter the loan amount: ")))
loan2 = Loan2(annual_interest_rate, number_of_years, loan_amount)
print("The monthly payment for the loan is: {:.2f} ".format(loan2.get_monthly_payment()))
print("The total payment for the loan is: {:.2f} ".format(loan2.get_total_payment()))
